Clarification: "29.340,79" appears to be an early-payment discounted amount; the invoice gross total remains "29.939,58". Use the gross invoice total as GrandTotal.Amount.

- Number formatting: source uses comma as decimal separator and thousand separators; must preserve same decimal places when extracting. Do not infer any other VAT rates or amounts.

4) Mapped extractions to schema fields (values identified for final extraction)
- Invoice.Date -> "31.01.2024"
- Sender.VatId -> "ATU39103108"
- Vat.Rate -> 10 (from "10,00 %")

5) Missing-data check
- All required schema fields are present in document; no need to leave fields empty.
